resources.string: Turn on Wireless debugging, then tap Activate. No new code is usually needed.
Tap Pair, then turn on Wireless debugging in Developer options.
Choose Pair device with pairing code. Leave that window open.
Pull down notifications, tap Enter pairing code and send the six digits. Sukut then activates automatically.
Everything stays on this phone. Once activated, you can turn Wireless debugging off and press Start on Home.
